explanations.6: The '%c' in the string is a special placeholder that tells console.log to apply the CSS styling in the second argument to the text that follows.
explanations.7: The \u{1F9AB} is Unicode escape syntax that renders as an emoji character (a meerkat icon in this case).
explanations.14: The empty array [] as the second argument to useEffect means this console message runs only once when the component first mounts, not on every render.
